result:
Everything in this task is shipped, but the critic scored the screens I re-checked at 3 of 5, below your finish line of 4.

**What's in the build:**
- **Tagline:** the story paragraph and the three step cards are gone, replaced by "Ascend. Pillage. Extract." (v30.41, Q51). Q53 (no raiders beside the logo) and Q72 (no PvP row) are also in.
- **Live backdrop:** behind the title, scoreboard and how-to pages there is now a dimmed live map with a scripted pillager-versus-robot fight (v30.69, v30.82; Q52, Q54). It is two pillagers and their robots with no full raid simulation, so it should be cheap. I have not measured 60 fps at 4K on the title.
- **This run (v30.90):** the title key line went from 8 hints to 5, and the top-right "go fullscreen" and "settings" buttons went from 44 to 48px. Crouch, backpack and map still show in the F1 controls list. The gate passed with the seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged.

**Critic scores:** I re-shot and judged 01, 45 and 57 after the final ship. All three scored 3. I did not re-run the critic on 44, 46 or 56 this run. Earlier runs scored 46 at 3 as well.

**What is holding the title at 3:**
- **Name box:** it shows "PILLAGER" in capitals. CSS can't lower it, so the value would have to be lowered where it is set, which risks the save and network names.
- **Logo:** it is a gold gradient, and the style guide bans gradients. An old fixture check requires one, so changing it means retargeting that check, and the logo is the brand mark.
- **Mode rows:** the five rows include a dead "coming later" server row.
- **Saves block:** it is 898px wide against a 558px menu column.
- **Attract cards (45, 46, 56):** the card needs a real "press any key" button, a 56px header and a 72px footer. That is shared attract-card work, not the backdrop.

I logged the changes in `notes/ui/changes.md` and the leftovers in `notes/03-title-and-backdrop.md`. I did not add anything to `questions.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: critic still 3 of 5 on 01, 45 and 57. Remaining: lowercase name input, flat logo (needs a retarget of old check 18.11), fewer mode rows, narrower saves block, attract-card button and header/footer structure, and a 4K 60 fps measurement.
